label: create-rect
js: (async () => { const sleep=(ms)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const canvas=document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas')||document.querySelector('canvas'); if(!canvas) return 'no-canvas';const tool=document.querySelector('[data-tool=rect]'); if(!tool) return 'no-tool'; tool.click(); await sleep(200);const b=canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); const p=(x,y)=>({bubbles:true,cancelable:true,view:window,clientX:b.left+x,clientY:b.top+y,button:0,buttons:1});canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',p(180,150))); await sleep(60);canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',p(260,200))); await sleep(60);canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',p(340,240))); await sleep(60);canvas.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{...p(340,240),buttons:0})); await sleep(500);const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=layer-object-row]')].map(e=>e.getAttribute('data-object-type'));return 'rows='+JSON.stringify(rows) })()

label: select-rect-and-open-props
js: (() => { const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=layer-object-row]')].find((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-object-type')==='rect'); if(!row) return 'no-row'; if(row.getAttribute('data-selected')!=='true') row.click(); const e=new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',altKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true}); window.dispatchEvent(e); document.dispatchEvent(e); return true })()

label: set-mode-index
js: (() => { const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid=object-props-dialog] [data-testid=color-change-mode]'); if(!e) return 'no-select'; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(e,'index'); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return true })()

label: set-mode-rgb
js: (() => { const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid=object-props-dialog] [data-testid=color-change-mode]'); if(!e) return 'no-select'; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(e,'rgb'); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return true })()

label: fill-pipe-values
js: (() => { const e=document.querySelector('[data-testid=object-props-dialog] [data-testid=color-change-input]'); if(!e) return 'no-input'; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set; setter.call(e,'#FF0000 | #00FF00'); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return true })()
